name: AppLovin
shortInfo: AppLovin help monetize and scale mobile apps.
brief: Applovin helps developers market, monetize, analyze and publish their apps through its mobile advertising, marketing, and analytics platforms MAX, AppDiscovery, and SparkLabs.
about: Get access to Advertising Report and much more through this Applovin connector. It enables streaming of relevant Applovin data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.
availableData:
##### Advertiser Report

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the Advertising Report from the AppLovin platform.
